title: Custom Furniture & Private House Renovation | DUMSKAYA
description: A DUMSKAYA DESIGN project: design and production of custom furniture and turnkey renovation of a private house. Photos of the completed project.
h1: Custom furniture design and manufacturing, plus a turnkey renovation of a private house

blocks.text: Custom furniture design and manufacturing, plus a turnkey renovation of a private house

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed and manufactured furniture for a private house and carried out its turnkey renovation.

Furniture was made for every room: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with storage systems and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom; built-in wardrobes and shelving were made as well.
Each piece was designed around the architecture and interior of the house and the owners’ needs and lifestyle.

Storage systems, materials and finishes, furniture proportions, and appliance integration were all carefully thought out. The furniture became part of the interior, and every bit of the house’s space is put to use.
The turnkey project included construction and finishing work, furniture manufacturing and installation, and the installation of lighting, plumbing fixtures, and other interior elements.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and manufactures custom furniture and delivers interiors and turnkey renovations in Slovakia, across Europe, and in the USA.
